case_sensitive.description: Match letter case exactly when true.
case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive

continuation.description: Opaque continuation returned by the same tool and unchanged query; do not edit it.
continuation.title: Continuation

glob.description: File glob limiting which files are searched.
glob.title: Glob

max_bytes_per_match.description: Maximum UTF-8 preview bytes returned for each match.
max_bytes_per_match.title: Max Bytes Per Match

path.description: File or directory relative to project root or scope_path; empty is root.
path.title: Path

project_id.description: Opaque project ID returned by projects_list; never send a local path.
project_id.title: Project Id

purpose.description: Concise user-facing reason shown in Windows approval and local activity history.
purpose.title: Purpose

query.description: Literal text to find, or a bounded regular expression when regex=true.
query.title: Query

regex.description: Interpret query as a regular expression.
regex.title: Regex

scope_path.description: Optional requested absolute Windows directory outside the project, e.g. C:/Temp. Local project policy and Windows approval still apply; not a trust assertion.
scope_path.title: Scope Path
